rationale.consistency: Using string(byte) on path characters is a Go pitfall that incorrectly encodes >127 byte values as UTF-8 runes instead of 1-byte strings.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails on percent-encoded multibyte characters due to the string(byte) bug, and applies case-insensitivity to the entire string instead of just hex digits.
rationale.scope: Implements the requested suffix stripping but improperly changes the matching semantics to fully case-insensitive based on an incorrect assumption.
rationale.readability: The logic is easy to follow, and the inline comments clearly explain the intention behind each step of the backwards iteration.
rationale.robustness: Correctly guards against out-of-bounds slice access during escape lookbacks and handles unescape errors safely without panicking.
rationale.maintainability: Removing the broken reverse() approach is an improvement, and the logic is self-contained without adding complex dependencies.
